title: Cycle safety net & skill-swap runway: pilot for managed contingency and rapid role swaps
creator: Evelyn Nguyen
description: Pilot a lightweight, repeatable protocol that (1) reserves a small, pre-authorized contingency bench for each initiative; (2) defines automated, data-driven decommit triggers to surface scope cuts early; and (3) enables 48-72h cross-team role swaps (skill-swap runway) for critical path owners. Goal: reduce mid-cycle emergency scope slippage and avoid over-committing hires/contractors while preserving predictable deliverables for high-variance launches.
acceptance_criteria: Bench reservation pattern documented and approved by Eng + DX leads (template + gating checklist)
Automated burn-rate and risk signals implemented in Cycle Dashboard for pilot initiatives (alerts fire at configured thresholds)
One end-to-end simulated swap executed during pilot week with handoff notes and <48h ramp for swapped engineer
Post-pilot metric: reduction in unplanned scope drop events for pilot initiatives by 40% vs last 3 cycles (tracking via Cycle Incident log)
tasks: Draft PRD and runbook for bench allocation heuristics (owner: PM)
Implement two decommit triggers in dashboard: velocity-drain and blocker-duration (owner: Eng Infra)
Create skill-swap playbook (on-call style runbook with shadowing checklist) (owner: DevEx)
Coordinate 2 pilot initiatives and confirm participation (owner: PM)
Run tabletop simulation and record learnings (owner: PM + Eng leads)
decisions: Reserve 8% of initiative FTE as default bench for pilot (rounded to nearest 0.25 FTE); explicit opt-out allowed with Exec sign-off
Decommit triggers will be permissive during pilot (alerts + human review) rather than automatic removal of scope
Skill-swap runway will initially cover only critical-path backend owners and SRE overlaps
Compensation budgeting for swaps will be covered from initiative contingency for pilot period

risks: Bench becomes a hidden buffer that masks underlying estimation issues — mitigated by requiring explicit owner sign-off and retrospective on every bench draw
Skill-swap ramp takes longer than expected for specialized work — mitigated by limiting initial pool to generalist backend/SRE overlaps and requiring 24h shadowing
Dashboard alerts generate noise and reduce trust — mitigated by conservative thresholds and human-in-the-loop review during pilot
